headline: Standing out in a Saturated Market
summary: Nearly 60% of Goodwill’s year arrives at Halloween, against mega-store competition. We made Goodwill synonymous with Halloween — and sales skyrocketed 38%.

question.h: One season, sixty percent of the year.
question.p: Goodwill, the king of thrift, is arguably the world’s most sustainable brand, with an armada of 80+ stores in SoCal alone. Nearly 60% of its annual revenue comes in during the Halloween season when folks are looking for one-of-a-kind costumes and competition from Halloween mega stores is fierce.

made.p: We made Goodwill synonymous with Halloween through a multi-channel campaign including video, social, out of home, digital, PR and activations.

happened.p: Young people flocked to the stores for their costumes and sales skyrocketed 38%. Many of these shoppers turned into loyal customers, brand ambassadors and influencers.

quote.text: It was such a privilege to work with The Miller Group. They’re a bright, energetic group that jumps in and offers brilliant strategic and creative solutions with high return on investment. Their award-winning Halloween campaign for Goodwill’s retail division was outstanding. Sales shot through the roof and left a lasting impression on people.
quote.short: Brilliant strategic and creative solutions with high return on investment.
quote.name: Christianne Van Grunsven

rationale: The biggest published number on her site (38%) — and it isn’t on her homepage today. Corrected “costumers” → “costumes.”
